pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

2. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

4. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 169
   D. 26

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

9. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 10

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 34
   D. 17

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 13

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

16. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

17. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

19. Solve for x: x + 4 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 4
   C. 8
   D. 5

20. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

21. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 24

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

24. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

26. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

27. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

28. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

29. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 21
   C. 30
   D. 90

30. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
